items.summary: Add two UI controls to adjust the simulation speed: a "Faster" control that halves the current generation tick interval on each press (e.g., 500ms → 250ms → 125ms …) and a "Slower" control that doubles the current tick interval on each press (e.g., 250ms → 500ms → 1000ms …).

Update the simulation loop so the tick interval is not a fixed constant and can be changed at runtime while the simulation is running or paused, without breaking Start/Pause/Reset behavior or the generation counter.
Display the current tick interval (or an equivalent speed indicator) in the controls panel in English so the user can see the active simulation speed.
